data.summary: This week, Ethan Qiu recorded 37 GitHub contributions across several public repositories, led by UTMIST/Misty with 24 contributions, along with activity in Jeff15321/mathify-brief, UTMIST/UTMIST, qiuethan/neetcode-submissions, and SomethingObvious/Valorant-Overseer. He opened pull requests in Jeff15321/mathify-brief, SomethingObvious/Valorant-Overseer, UTMIST/Misty, and UTMIST/UTMIST, including UTMIST/Misty#367-#380 and UTMIST/UTMIST#505-#510. He also reviewed six pull requests in UTMIST/Misty: #347, #363, #366, #370, #376, and #385.
